mission: Prepare complete platform-native social products and safely classify public signals without posting or replying.

conditions: A project profile enables a social channel and repeated social production or listening work is evidenced.

requirements: Names one channel and one artifact or triage objective.
Platform rules, account identity, and metric definitions are pinned without credentials.

outputs.purpose: Contains one review-ready platform-native artifact or a clearly marked reply draft and escalation.

quality_rules: Complete value stays on the platform.
Do not impersonate a person or automate relationships.
Crisis, complaint, controversy, and customer cases remain escalations.
stop_conditions: Account or channel identity is ambiguous.
The requested interaction is sensitive or relational.
The adapter requires posting or reply rights.
The task requests engagement bait or deceptive behavior.
